A.status: One Tx and two independent Rx windings with candidate differential pairing. Three drawn rectangular perimeter passes per winding are a proposed packaging topology, not an electrically selected or validated coil design.
A.standoff_definition: 1000 minus maximum bare winding core Z, excluding separate terminal pins. Compare separate core, insulation and terminal extrema below.
A.outer_size_definition: Nominal main-perimeter insulation envelope only; return and terminal tails extend beyond it.

winding_footprints_mm.excludes: Separate terminal pins and nonmetallic terminal inserts; use part bounds for the complete detail.

B.status: One transverse Tx and two opposite independent Rx windings; pairing, polarity and balance are unoptimized. Main paths are in XZ planes, with recessed out-of-plane returns. Reversal is not a new independent excitation direction.
B.outer_size_definition: Nominal main-perimeter insulation envelope only; return and terminal tails extend beyond it.

winding_footprints_mm.excludes: Separate terminal pins and nonmetallic terminal inserts; use part bounds for the complete detail.

limitations: Central 180 mm lane is a mechanical experimental arrangement, not sensor coverage or accepted material limits.
Full-width arrays, fields, sensitivity, metal/host compatibility, timing and process performance are unvalidated.
Coil conductors and leads are intentionally inside the experimental metal-exclusion reservation. Its final extent must be measured.
